from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
ROOT=Path.cwd();R29="reports/research/510300_bank_industry_constraint_source_probe_v1";R30="reports/research/510300_bank_current_vintage_ratio_cause_identity_v1"
OUT=ROOT/"reports/research/510300_bank_release_vintage_and_nim_definition_probe_v1"
assert not OUT.exists(),"研究已登记，不能重复启动"
proposal=json.loads((ROOT/R30/"next_experiment.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert proposal["experiment_id"]=="E31"
refs=[R30+"/next_experiment.json",R30+"/result.json",R29+"/protocol.json",R29+"/result.json",R29+"/source_gate.json",
R29+"/字段定义与已证实断点.json",R29+"/发布正文与年度滚动表时钟.json",R29+"/request_ledger.json",
R29+"/官方正文_data_docId=1233335.json",R29+"/官方正文_data_docId=1208453.json",R29+"/原表九个拟议字段单元格与格式.json",
R29+"/9a20b3d34d24444bbdd77a210675a95c.xls",R29+"/Script.js",R29+"/ItemDetail.js",
R29+"/原研究权限与账户口径快照.json"]
assert all((ROOT/f).is_file() for f in refs)
ledger=json.loads((ROOT/R29/"request_ledger.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
failed=[x["url"] for x in ledger if not x.get("raw_saved")]
assert len(failed)==2
OUT.mkdir()
protocol={"study_id":"510300_BANK_RELEASE_VINTAGE_AND_NIM_DEFINITION_PROBE_V1","experiment_id":"E31",
"registered_at":datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat(),
"previous_goal_turn_classification":"PROGRESS_E29_SOURCE_BREAKS_AND_E30_TWO_FIXED_QUARTER_CAUSE_IDENTITIES_COMPLETED",
"question":proposal["question"],"hypotheses":["原季度独立发布正文可能保留当期舍入数值与日期，但不证明当前年度附件当时原版。","监管方法原件可能给出净息差计算期间；公司或媒体定义不直接代替行业统计定义。"],
"evidence_scope":proposal["proposed_evidence_scope"],"budget":proposal["proposed_budget"],
"allowed_primary_source_hosts":["nfra.gov.cn","cbirc.gov.cn","pbc.gov.cn"],
"primary_source_rule":"银行监管统计定义优先NFRA/CBIRC；PBOC方法仅明确同一监管指标口径才支持，不将泛称金融/公司口径转移。媒体仅定位，不能准入数值/定义。",
"known_failed_urls_do_not_retry":failed,
"reused_source_routes":"原保存官方Script.js的apiUrl_cdn与getCDN、ItemDetail.js的docId接口；无需重新下载脚本。",
"clock_rule":"经济统计期、正文显示publishDate、docEditdate、当前附件时间与当前下载收件分别保存；不声称首版/首次收件或精确首次公开时刻。",
"admission_limit":"少量季度只回答本有限版本/方法问题，不能宣布原完整31季度/全部成熟成员支持。未注册特征或模型，不重开旧失败。",
"stop_conditions":["2查询/最多10新URL或固定下载超时后结束，已知失败URL不重试。","没有官方同口径定义则净息差期间继续未知。","当前年度附件不回填、缺口不记0或移除原成熟成员；仅有同值不能证明首版。"],
"parents":[{"path":f,"sha256":hashlib.sha256((ROOT/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for f in refs],
"new_fits":0,"new_training_labels":0,"new_full_accounts":0,"source_code_edits":0,"orders_authorized":False,
"new_prospective_forecasts_enabled":False,"goal_achieved":False,"current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET"}
(OUT/"protocol.json").write_text(json.dumps(protocol,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
(OUT/"request_ledger.json").write_text("[]\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"E31":"有限原季度版本/息差方法问题已登记","父文件":len(refs),"禁止重试旧失败":len(failed),"拟合":0,"账户":0,"源码修改":0},ensure_ascii=False))
